sql:
SELECT
    coalesce(pc.ProductCategoryName, 'Unknown') AS product_category,
    sum(t.return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    sum(t.sales_quantity) AS total_sales_quantity,
    round(sum(t.return_quantity) / nullIf(sum(t.sales_quantity), 0), 4) AS return_rate
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        SalesQuantity AS sales_quantity,
        ReturnQuantity AS return_quantity
    FROM retail.FactSales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        SalesQuantity AS sales_quantity,
        ReturnQuantity AS return_quantity
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS t
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p
    ON t.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps
    ON toInt32OrNull(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, product_category ASC
